description: Lists the plan's work: every task on the calendar of one plan revision, each with its id, key, kind, engine, who does it (executor), title, channel, day, state, forecast (expected), the number that verifies it, what it is linked to (refs) and when it last changed. Use it to see what is planned or where a piece stands; work_get opens one row whole with its history and numbers, and the later days still held as slots are in situation_read. Every row of the revision, never a page of them.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

revision.description: The plan revision to read, as journal_read lists them; null for the current plan.

state.description: Which rows: scheduled (waits for its day to reach the week ahead), planned (in the week, not started), accepted (its engine took it), in_progress (being made), awaiting_owner (a card waits for the owner), published (went out), done (finished), dropped, failed or cancelled; all for every state.

name: work_list
title: Work list
